blocks.text: Unleash your inner fashion designer and learn how to live colorfully with the Barbie Makeup Artist Magazine by Horizon Group USA! Barbie and her Dream Team dish on their favorite fashion tips to empower you to create mer-mazing looks from head to toe and radiate positivity! Complete with 9 eyeshadows, 4 lip glosses, blush, crayons, and stencils — this beauty set includes everything you need to shine bright like the stars! Use the included stencils to color in hair and make-up designs with tons of vibrant colors, then apply the eyeshadows to the pages in the book to express your magic! Stick on the good vibes and have the time of your life mixing and matching repositionable stickers to create sweet & bold outfits — don’t forget the surprise scratch art stickers that turn up the FUN! The Barbie Makeup Artist Magazine set is filled with positive affirmations that help little fashionistas channel their limitless potential. It’s the perfect way to introduce aspiring beauty gurus age 6+ to the exciting world of make-up by letting them practice on a sketchbook first!

items.label: LEARN HOW TO LIVE COLORFULLY
items.value: Open up the spiral-bound make-up artist magazine and create all kinds of looks for your favorite Barbie Dream Team!

items.label: MAKEOVER MAGIC
items.value: Use the stencils to color in pretty hair & makeup designs using pretend eyeshadows, crayons, and even lip glosses!

items.label: INCLUDES MAKEUP ESSENTIALS
items.value: Cosmetic brushes and eyeshadow applicators are both included, so you can practice your make-up techniques like a pro!

items.label: SURPRISE SCRATCH ART STICKERS
items.value: Turn up the FUN as you scratch & reveal surprise sticker designs, then mix & match the repositionable stickers to create sweet & bold outfits — removing & re-sticking until your look shines as bright as the stars!

items.label: SET INCLUDES
items.value: 1 Spiral-Bound Make-Up Artist Magazine (10.5 x 10.9 in.), 4 Stencil Sheets, 3 Repositionable Sticker Sheets, 1 Scratch Art Sticker Sheet, 4 Double-Sided Art Papers, 6 Crayons (Pink, Black, Light Brown, Red, Teal, Yellow), 28 Printed Design Pages, 9 Pretend Play Eyeshadow Cakes (Blue, Cool Gray, Green, Light Blue, Light Pink, Orange, Pink, Purple, Teal), 4 Pretend Play Lip Glosses (2 Pink, 1 Purple, 1 Red), 1 Pretend Play Pink Blush Cake, 1 Eyeshadow Brush, 1 Cosmetic Brush

items.label: Included Components
